name: Symmetric downlight
description: A proposed lighting arrangement for ceiling-luminaire visualization.
scope: Original finite-emitter authoring realization, not measured photometry. The complete JSON rig is authoritative; reference-origin HDR loses finite-source parallax and is a separately labelled projection.
preview_scope: Actual SolidCraft GPU image; 64 samples, denoised. Read the receipt/variant; this is not a convergence or full-physics claim.
limitations: Original luminaire-shaped area source, not measured IES/LDT intensity distribution or lux validation.
Native GPU realization uses a finite rectangular emitter; a directional/spot angular model is retained as intent, not silently equated to a measured fixture.
